lightbr.config.title: LightBR Config
lightbr.config.enabled.name: Enabled
lightbr.config.enabled.desc: Whether LightBR is enabled or not.
lightbr.config.chunk_xz_radius.name: Chunk XZ Radius (Horizontal Radius)
lightbr.config.chunk_xz_radius.desc: Horizontal chunk radius around track chunks to keep rendered. Higher values render more surrounding chunks.
lightbr.config.chunk_y_radius.name: Chunk Y Radius (Vertical Radius)
lightbr.config.chunk_y_radius.desc: Vertical section radius around track sections to keep rendered. Higher values render more sections above and below.
lightbr.config.render_all_water.name: Render All Water
lightbr.config.render_all_water.desc: Whether all water should be rendered or not. This includes water both inside and outside of chunk radius. Disabling this means only water inside chunk radius will be rendered.
lightbr.config.render_all_lava.name: Render All Lava
lightbr.config.render_all_lava.desc: Whether all lava should be rendered or not. This includes lava both inside and outside of chunk radius. Disabling this means only lava inside chunk radius will be rendered.
lightbr.config.render_group.name: Default Settings
lightbr.config.server_controlled.name: Server Control
lightbr.config.server_controlled.desc: When active, the server controls some of LightBR settings. Default settings apply only when the server does not apply its own settings.
lightbr.config.experimental_group.name: Experimental
lightbr.config.experimental_group.desc: Experimental features. These are not fully tested!
lightbr.config.auto_fix_incomplete_chunk: When a track block is found during chunk rendering, triggers a second pass to fill in nearby sections that were skipped. Eliminates visual gaps near track blocks but causes one extra chunk rebuild on initial load.
lightbr.config.applied_values_group.name: Applied Values
lightbr.config.applied_values_group.desc: These are the values currently used by LightBR. "Server" means that the value comes from the server and "Default" means that the value comes from the defaults declared in "Default Settings" section
lightbr.config.applied.enabled.name: Enabled
lightbr.config.applied.enabled.desc: Whether LightBR is enabled or not.
lightbr.config.applied.chunk_xz_radius.d: Horizontal chunk radius around track chunks to keep rendered. Higher values render more surrounding chunks.
lightbr.config.applied.chunk_y_radius.de: Vertical section radius around track sections to keep rendered. Higher values render more sections above and below.

lightbr.config.applied.render_all_lava.d: Whether all lava should be rendered or not. This includes lava both inside and outside of chunk radius.
lightbr.config.applied.always_render_reg: Regions that will always be rendered, regardless of chunk radius. This value can only be configured by servers to declare regions that must be rendered at all times (track decorations, lobby, etc).
lightbr.log.disconnect_cleared: [LightBR] Disconnected from world. Track cache cleared.
lightbr.log.acknowledge_received: [LightBR] Server acknowledged LightBR. Server control is now active.
